arguments.prompt: Use case precise-object-edit. Image1 is the edit target: preserve EXACT composition, poses, anatomy, silhouettes, limb ownership, grounding, color markings and every rooftop object. Correct ONLY the coat rendering on the TWO DOGS. Erase ALL looping engraved strokes, curly hair marks, repeated thin strokes and directional strand fields on torso, neck and upper legs. PAINT THESE BODY AREAS AS ONLY FOUR LARGE UNBROKEN SMOOTH FLAT WATERCOLOR VALUE SHAPES, like the completely smooth animation-cel body finish in image2. Absolutely zero fur-texture marks within dog trunk/neck/upper-leg planes. Image2 supplies FINISH ONLY, never anatomy, pose or scene. Preserve Buddy's exact longer connected body, neck nuzzling Heather knee, three visible grounded legs and fourth occluded behind human; preserve pale regional markings, furnished moustache/beard, brows, local ear/paw hair. Preserve Neet full narrow body, four fine supported legs, large ears, face, chest bib and near-flush nub. Keep the proud-versus-relieved expressions, chair, Heather hands/jeans/shoes, broom, fallen colorful dupatta, broken terracotta pots, soil, silver can, plants, parapet and framing unchanged. Do not redraw body shapes or enlarge heads. No text.
